roadmap.title: Early biomes and first runs
roadmap.description: Reach the early biomes, find the first exploration unlocks and learn the run loop.

roadmap.title: Runes and exploration
roadmap.description: Collect the runes and secret-area unlocks that open new routes.

roadmap.title: Base-game bosses and biomes
roadmap.description: Reach the later biomes and beat the base-game bosses.

roadmap.title: Feats and weapon goals
roadmap.description: Complete the one-off feats, kill goals and weapon unlock goals.

roadmap.title: DLC content
roadmap.description: Play the paid DLC biomes and bosses for their achievements.

roadmap.title: Boss Stem Cell difficulty
roadmap.description: Win runs at higher Boss Stem Cell counts.

roadmap.title: Hardest restricted goals
roadmap.description: Finish the no-damage, speed and other restricted challenges.

achievements.description: Reach the Promenade of the Condemned for the first time.
achievements.summary: Make your first visit to the @loc{Promenade of the Condemned}.

steps.text: Take the @loc{Promenade of the Condemned} exit from @loc{Prisoners' Quarters}.

achievements.description: Reach the Ramparts for the first time.
achievements.summary: Make your first visit to the @loc{Ramparts}.

steps.text: Take the @loc{Ramparts} exit from the @loc{Promenade of the Condemned} or the @loc{Toxic Sewers}.

achievements.description: Reach the Black Bridge for the first time.
achievements.summary: Make your first visit to the @loc{Black Bridge}.

steps.text: Take the @loc{Black Bridge} exit from the @loc{Ramparts}.

achievements.description: Reach the Ossuary for the first time.
achievements.summary: Make your first visit to the @loc{Ossuary}.

steps.text: Kill the elite @enemy{Slasher} in the Toxic Sewers room that holds the @item{Teleportation Rune} and pick the rune up.
Take the @loc{Ossuary} exit from the @loc{Promenade of the Condemned}.

achievements.description: Reach the Toxic Sewers for the first time.
achievements.summary: Make your first visit to the @loc{Toxic Sewers}.

steps.text: In the @loc{Promenade of the Condemned}, enter the hall below the overpass, kill the elite @enemy{Undead Archer} and pick up the @item{Vine Rune}.
Take the @loc{Toxic Sewers} exit from @loc{Prisoners' Quarters}.

achievements.description: Reach the Ancient Sewers for the first time.
achievements.summary: Make your first visit to the @loc{Ancient Sewers}.

steps.text: Kill the elite @enemy{Slasher} in the special room of the @loc{Ossuary} and pick up the @item{Ram Rune}.
In a later run, take the @loc{Ancient Sewers} exit from the @loc{Toxic Sewers}.

achievements.description: Reach the Stilt Village for the first time.
achievements.summary: Make your first visit to the @loc{Stilt Village}.

steps.text: Beat the @enemy{Concierge} on the @loc{Black Bridge}, then take the @loc{Stilt Village} exit.

achievements.displayName: The dead center of the island...
achievements.description: Reach the Graveyard for the first time.
achievements.summary: Make your first visit to the @loc{Graveyard}.

steps.text: Pick up the @item{Spider Rune} in the @loc{Slumbering Sanctuary}.
In a later run, beat the boss of the @loc{Insufferable Crypt} and take the @loc{Graveyard} exit.

achievements.displayName: It rubs the lotion on its skin!
achievements.description: Reach the Prison Depths for the first time.
achievements.summary: Make your first visit to the @loc{Prison Depths}.

steps.text: Pick up the @item{Spider Rune} in the @loc{Slumbering Sanctuary}.
In a later run, take the @loc{Prison Depths} exit from the @loc{Promenade of the Condemned}.

achievements.description: Absorb the Vine Rune.
achievements.summary: Absorb the Vine Rune.

steps.text: Find the hall under the overpass in @loc{Promenade of the Condemned} and enter the room.
Defeat the elite @enemy{Undead Archer} and pick up the @item{Vine Rune}.

achievements.displayName: What are you rubbing at anyway?
achievements.description: Absorb the Teleportation rune.
achievements.summary: Absorb the Teleportation Rune.

steps.text: Use the @item{Vine Rune} to pass from @loc{Prisoners' Quarters} to @loc{Toxic Sewers}, then find the elite room.
Defeat the elite @enemy{Slasher} and pick up the @item{Teleportation Rune}.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy with an elevator.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with an elevator.

steps.text: Lead an enemy under a moving elevator so the elevator crushes it.

achievements.description: Die by being killed by an elevator.
achievements.summary: Die by being killed by an elevator.

steps.text: Stand under a moving elevator and let it crush you.

achievements.description: Cheat Death…
achievements.summary: Survive a lethal hit with the Ygdar Orus Li Ox mutation.

steps.text: At the first mutation choice after leaving @loc{Prisoners' Quarters}, take @item{Ygdar Orus Li Ox} from @npc{Guillain}.
Take lethal damage while you are not cursed so the mutation saves you.

achievements.description: Die in a run while you hold 100 or more cells.
achievements.summary: Die in a run while you hold 100 or more cells.

steps.text: Collect 100 or more cells in one run without spending them at @npc{The Collector}.
Die with them still on you.

achievements.description: You beat "The Concierge"!
achievements.summary: Defeat the @enemy{Concierge}.

steps.text: Go through the @loc{Prisoners' Quarters}, @loc{Promenade of the Condemned} and @loc{Ramparts} to the @loc{Black Bridge}.
Defeat the @enemy{Concierge}.

achievements.displayName: Is there something in your eye?
achievements.description: You beat "Conjunctivius"!
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Conjunctivius}.

steps.text: Reach the @loc{Insufferable Crypt} through the @loc{Toxic Sewers} and @loc{Ancient Sewers}, using the @item{Ram Rune} on the default path.
Defeat @enemy{Conjunctivius}.

achievements.description: You slayed 100 elites. Badman.
achievements.summary: Defeat 100 elite enemies.

steps.text: Kill every elite enemy you meet until the total reaches 100.
To get more elites, unlock the @item{Tainted Flask} mutation (blueprint from the sixth @enemy{Time Keeper} kill, cost 50) and equip it so one more elite spawns in each biome.

achievements.description: Defeat the  without being hit even once.
achievements.summary: Defeat the @enemy{Concierge} without being hit even once.

steps.text: Practise the fight in the Training Room if needed, then defeat the @enemy{Concierge} on the @loc{Black Bridge} without being hit.

achievements.description: Defeat  without being hit even once.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Conjunctivius} without being hit even once.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Conjunctivius} in the @loc{Insufferable Crypt} without being hit.

achievements.description: Unlock 10 weapons.
achievements.summary: Unlock 10 weapons.

steps.text: Collect weapon blueprints from enemy drops and secret areas.
Turn blueprints in to @npc{The Collector} in a passage and pay the cells for 10 weapons.

achievements.description: Unlock 10 skills.
achievements.summary: Unlock 10 skills.

steps.text: Collect skill blueprints from enemy drops and secret areas.
Turn blueprints in to @npc{The Collector} in a passage and pay the cells for 10 skills.

achievements.description: Reach the Forgotten Sepulcher for the first time!
achievements.summary: Make your first visit to the @loc{Forgotten Sepulcher}.

steps.text: Take the @loc{Forgotten Sepulcher} exit from the @loc{Slumbering Sanctuary}.

achievements.description: Land a downward smash attack onto spikes.
achievements.summary: Land a downward smash attack onto spikes.

steps.text: Find a spike trap and use a downward smash attack in the air so you land on it.

achievements.displayName: What? There's nothing wrong with these...
achievements.description: Finish the game still carrying the Rusty Sword, Beginner's Bow and Old Wooden Shield.
achievements.summary: Finish the game still carrying the Rusty Sword, Beginner's Bow and Old Wooden Shield.

guide.context: A weapon stored in the backpack cannot be used until you swap it in.

steps.text: Keep the @item{Rusty Sword}, @item{Beginner's Bow} and @item{Old Wooden Shield}, and do not drop or replace them.
Unlock the @item{Backpack} upgrade (it needs 15 unlocked items) so one of them can stay stored while you use the other two.
Finish the game with all three still on you.

achievements.description: Be cursed... Survive.
achievements.summary: Get cursed, then kill enough enemies to lift the curse without dying.

steps.text: Get cursed, for example by opening a cursed chest.
Kill enemies to bring the curse counter down and avoid every hit, trap, pit and poison, because any damage kills you while cursed.
Keep killing until the curse is lifted.

achievements.description: Open your first timed door.
achievements.summary: Open a timed door before its timer runs out.

steps.text: Rush through @loc{Prisoners' Quarters} and reach the door in the following passage within 2 minutes of run time.
Interact with the door to open it.

achievements.displayName: See, that wasn't so hard now, was it?
achievements.description: Successfully complete a Challenge Rift.
achievements.summary: Complete a Challenge Rift by crossing its trap course to the end.

steps.text: Interact with the special symbol in the floor of a non-boss biome to enter a @mechanic{Challenge Rift}.
Open the chest at the start; the exit closes behind you.
Cross the trap-filled course to its end to escape.

achievements.description: Find your first secret zone.
achievements.summary: Find your first secret zone.

steps.text: Look for hidden spots in walls while exploring a biome, and enter the first secret area you reveal.

achievements.description: You finished a daily challenge. Well done!
achievements.summary: Complete one Daily Challenge run by defeating its boss within the time limit.

steps.text: Start the @mechanic{Daily Run} from its entrance in @loc{Prisoners' Quarters}, which opens once you hold the Challenger's Rune.
Reach the boss room and defeat the @enemy{Concierge} within 4 minutes 30 seconds.

achievements.description: Absorb the Challenger Rune!
achievements.summary: Absorb the Challenger's Rune.

steps.text: Reach @loc{Black Bridge}.
Defeat @enemy{The Concierge} and pick up the @item{Challenger's Rune}.

achievements.description: You have beaten the "Time Keeper"!
achievements.summary: Defeat the @enemy{Time Keeper}.

steps.text: Go from the @loc{Black Bridge} through the @loc{Stilt Village} and @loc{Clock Tower} to the @loc{Clock Room}.
Defeat the @enemy{Time Keeper}.

achievements.description: Defeat the  without being hit even once.
achievements.summary: Defeat the @enemy{Time Keeper} without being hit even once.

steps.text: Defeat the @enemy{Time Keeper} in the @loc{Clock Room} without being hit.

achievements.description: Reach the Clock Tower for the first time!
achievements.summary: Make your first visit to the @loc{Clock Tower}.

steps.text: Take the @loc{Clock Tower} exit from the @loc{Stilt Village}.

achievements.description: Reach the Clock Room for the first time!
achievements.summary: Make your first visit to the @loc{Clock Room}.

steps.text: Take the @loc{Clock Room} exit from the @loc{Clock Tower}.

achievements.displayName: Fortune and glory, kid. Fortune and Glory...
achievements.description: Reach the Slumbering Sanctuary for the first time!
achievements.summary: Make your first visit to the @loc{Slumbering Sanctuary}.

steps.text: Beat the boss of the @loc{Insufferable Crypt}, then take the @loc{Slumbering Sanctuary} exit.

achievements.description: Absorb the Spider's Rune!
achievements.summary: Absorb the Spider Rune.

steps.text: Reach @loc{Slumbering Sanctuary}.
Find the elite room, defeat the @enemy{Caster} and pick up the @item{Spider Rune}.

achievements.description: Finish the game with the Ygdar Orus Li Ox mutation in your possession.
achievements.summary: Finish the game with the Ygdar Orus Li Ox mutation in your possession.

steps.text: At the first mutation choice after leaving @loc{Prisoners' Quarters}, take @item{Ygdar Orus Li Ox} from @npc{Guillain}; it cannot be taken later.
Keep it through the final boss and finish the game.

achievements.description: Beat the final boss of the game while carrying the Cursed Sword.
achievements.summary: Beat the final boss of the game while carrying the @item{Cursed Sword}.

steps.text: Beat @enemy{Conjunctivius} three times, until the @item{Cursed Sword} blueprint drops on the 3rd kill, then unlock it for 150 cells.
Start a run with the sword and avoid all damage; any hit kills you while it is carried, even in the backpack.
Beat the final boss with the sword still in your inventory.

achievements.description: Absorb the Ram's Rune.
achievements.summary: Absorb the Ram Rune.

steps.text: Use the @item{Teleportation Rune} to take the route from @loc{Promenade of the Condemned} to @loc{Ossuary}, then find the special elite room.
Defeat the elite @enemy{Slasher} and pick up the @item{Ram Rune}.

achievements.description: Absorb your first Boss Stem Cell.
achievements.summary: Absorb your first Boss Stem Cell by beating a final boss with no Boss Stem Cells active.

guide.context: Do not use an aspect on the run.

steps.text: Start a run with every @mechanic{Boss Stem Cell} removed.
Beat @enemy{The Hand of the King}.

achievements.description: Absorb your second Boss Stem Cell.
achievements.summary: Absorb your second Boss Stem Cell by beating a final boss with one Boss Stem Cell active.

guide.context: Do not use an aspect on the run.

steps.text: Start a run with exactly 1 @mechanic{Boss Stem Cell} active.
Beat @enemy{The Hand of the King}.

achievements.description: Absorb your third Boss Stem Cell.
achievements.summary: Absorb your third Boss Stem Cell by beating a final boss with two Boss Stem Cells active.

guide.context: Do not use an aspect on the run.

steps.text: Start a run with exactly 2 @mechanic{Boss Stem Cell}s active.
Beat @enemy{The Hand of the King}.

achievements.displayName: Up, Guards, and at them again!
achievements.description: Win a run by beating the final boss with one Boss Stem Cell active.
achievements.summary: Win a run by beating the final boss with one @mechanic{Boss Stem Cell} active.

steps.text: Before leaving the starting area, set 1 @mechanic{Boss Stem Cell} active in the Boss Stem Cell tube in the starting area.
Play through and beat the @enemy{Hand of the King}.

achievements.description: Win a run by beating the final boss with two Boss Stem Cells active.
achievements.summary: Win a run by beating the final boss with two @mechanic{Boss Stem Cells} active.

steps.text: Before leaving the starting area, set 2 @mechanic{Boss Stem Cells} active in the Boss Stem Cell tube in the starting area.
Play through and beat the @enemy{Hand of the King}.

achievements.description: Win a run by beating the final boss with three Boss Stem Cells active.
achievements.summary: Win a run by beating the final boss with three @mechanic{Boss Stem Cells} active.

steps.text: Before leaving the starting area, set 3 @mechanic{Boss Stem Cells} active in the Boss Stem Cell tube in the starting area.
Play through and beat the @enemy{Hand of the King}.

achievements.description: Beat the Hand of the King.
achievements.summary: Defeat the @enemy{Hand of the King}.

steps.text: Go from the @loc{Clock Room} through the @loc{High Peak Castle} to the @loc{Throne Room}.
Defeat the @enemy{Hand of the King}.

achievements.displayName: Do you need... A hand?? Bahaha!
achievements.description: Win the boss fight against the  without being hit even once.
achievements.summary: Win the boss fight against the @enemy{Hand of the King} without being hit even once.

steps.text: Defeat the @enemy{Hand of the King} in the @loc{Throne Room} without being hit.

achievements.description: Absorb your fourth Boss Stem Cell.
achievements.summary: Absorb your fourth Boss Stem Cell by beating a final boss with three Boss Stem Cells active.

guide.context: Do not use an aspect on the run.

steps.text: Start a run with exactly 3 @mechanic{Boss Stem Cell}s active.
Beat @enemy{The Hand of the King}.

achievements.displayName: Let's get down to the nitty gritty...
achievements.description: Win a run by beating the final boss with four Boss Stem Cells active.
achievements.summary: Win a run by beating the final boss with four @mechanic{Boss Stem Cells} active.

steps.text: Before leaving the starting area, set 4 @mechanic{Boss Stem Cells} active in the Boss Stem Cell tube in the starting area.
Play through and beat the @enemy{Hand of the King}.

achievements.displayName: Please leave your shoes at the entrance.
achievements.description: Reach the Castle for the first time.
achievements.summary: Make your first visit to @loc{High Peak Castle}.

steps.text: Beat the boss of the @loc{Clock Room}, then take the @loc{High Peak Castle} exit.

achievements.displayName: Bend the knee? I think not…
achievements.description: Reach the Throne Room for the first time.
achievements.summary: Make your first visit to the @loc{Throne Room}.

steps.text: Beat the boss of the @loc{Clock Room} and enter @loc{High Peak Castle}.
Clear the elite behind any two of the three colors' doors and collect 2 Castle Keys, then use them.
Take the @loc{Throne Room} exit.

achievements.displayName: Even the rats avoid the place...
achievements.description: Reach the Insufferable Crypt for the first time.
achievements.summary: Make your first visit to the @loc{Insufferable Crypt}.

steps.text: Reach the @loc{Ancient Sewers} and take the @loc{Insufferable Crypt} exit.

achievements.description: Absorb your fifth Boss Stem Cell.
achievements.summary: Absorb your fifth Boss Stem Cell by beating The Giant with four Boss Stem Cells active.

guide.context: Do not use an aspect on the run.

steps.text: Beat @enemy{Hand of the King} to get the @item{Homunculus Rune}, then pick up the Cavern Key in @loc{Prisoners' Quarters}.
Start a run with exactly 4 @mechanic{Boss Stem Cell}s active.
Use the Cavern Key on the gate to @loc{Cavern} in the @loc{Graveyard} and go on to @loc{Guardian's Haven}.
Beat @enemy{The Giant}.

achievements.description: You beat the Giant!
achievements.summary: Defeat the @enemy{Giant} in @loc{Guardian's Haven}.

steps.text: Beat the @enemy{Hand of the King} once so the Giant wakes in the @loc{Prisoners' Quarters}.
In a new run, follow the Giant through the broken door and pick up the @item{Cavern Key}.
Use the key on the @loc{Cavern} gate in the @loc{Graveyard}, go to @loc{Guardian's Haven}, and defeat the @enemy{Giant}.

achievements.description: Defeat the  on 5 .
achievements.summary: Defeat the @enemy{Collector} on 5 @mechanic{Boss Stem Cells}.

steps.text: Beat the @enemy{Giant} with four @mechanic{Boss Stem Cells} active to get the fifth cell, then set 5 @mechanic{Boss Stem Cells} before a new run.
Go through the @loc{Throne Room} and @loc{Astrolab} to the @loc{Observatory}.
Defeat the @enemy{Collector}.

achievements.description: Reach the Cavern for the first time.
achievements.summary: Make your first visit to the @loc{Cavern}.

steps.text: Beat the @enemy{Hand of the King} once so the @item{Homunculus Rune} lets you open the large entrance door in @loc{Prisoners' Quarters}.
Open that door and take the @item{Cavern Key}.
In a later run, take the @loc{Cavern} exit from the @loc{Graveyard}.

achievements.description: Reach the Guardian's Haven for the first time.
achievements.summary: Make your first visit to the @loc{Guardian's Haven}.

steps.text: Take the @loc{Guardian's Haven} exit from the @loc{Cavern}.

achievements.description: Reach the Astrolab for the first time.
achievements.summary: Make your first visit to the @loc{Astrolab}.

steps.text: Get your fifth @mechanic{Boss Stem Cell} and set all 5 active in the Tube at the start of a run.
Reach the @loc{Throne Room} and take its exit to the @loc{Astrolab}.

achievements.description: Reach the Observatory for the first time.
achievements.summary: Make your first visit to the @loc{Observatory}.

steps.text: Clear the @loc{Astrolab}: beat the elites that drop the Allen Key, Elevator Key and 2 Guardian's Keys.
Use the keys to open their doors and take the exit to the @loc{Observatory}.

achievements.description: Defeat the  without being hit even once.
achievements.summary: Defeat the @enemy{Giant} without being hit even once.

steps.text: Defeat the @enemy{Giant} in @loc{Guardian's Haven} without being hit.

achievements.description: Defeat the  without being hit even once.
achievements.summary: Defeat the @enemy{Collector} without being hit even once.

steps.text: With 5 @mechanic{Boss Stem Cells} active, reach the @loc{Observatory} and defeat the @enemy{Collector} without being hit.

achievements.displayName: I've got my eyes on you...
achievements.description: Defeat  in the .
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Mama Tick} in the @loc{Nest}.

steps.text: Reach the @loc{Nest} through the @loc{Morass of the Banished}; the default path needs the @item{Teleportation Rune}.
Do not sacrifice @item{Mushroom Boi!}; fight and defeat @enemy{Mama Tick}.

achievements.description: Defeat  without being hit even once.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Mama Tick} without being hit even once.

steps.text: Fight @enemy{Mama Tick} in the @loc{Nest} without sacrificing @item{Mushroom Boi!} and avoid every hit.

achievements.description: Finish the game without sacrificing the Mushroom Boi!
achievements.summary: Finish the game without sacrificing your Mushroom Boi! pet.

steps.text: Get @item{Mushroom Boi!} from a Jerkshroom and unlock it with the Collector.
Summon it. Do not use the skill again while it is out. Keep it away from the @loc{Morass of the Banished} altar.
Beat the final boss with the Mushroom Boi still active.

achievements.description: Blow up your summoned Mushroom Boi! by activating its skill a second time.
achievements.summary: Blow up your summoned Mushroom Boi! by activating its skill a second time.

steps.text: Get @item{Mushroom Boi!} from a Jerkshroom and unlock it with the Collector.
Summon it, then activate the skill a second time to make it explode.

achievements.description: Sacrifice the  skill at the altar in the  so that  is appeased and does not fight.
achievements.summary: Sacrifice the @item{Mushroom Boi!} skill at the altar in the @loc{Morass of the Banished} so that @enemy{Mama Tick} is appeased and does not fight.

steps.text: Unlock @item{Mushroom Boi!} from the blueprint that @enemy{Jerkshroom} enemies drop, then equip it as a skill.
Cross the @loc{Morass of the Banished} to the altar of the @npc{Swamp Priest} at the end of the biome.
Activate @item{Mushroom Boi!}, then activate it again while it is following you so it jumps onto the altar.
Go on into the @loc{Nest} and do not hit @enemy{Mama Tick}'s eye when it rises above the water.

achievements.description: Clear the opening biome, Prisoners' Quarters, without smashing any door.
achievements.summary: Clear the opening biome, Prisoners' Quarters, without smashing any door.

steps.text: Reach the exit of @loc{Prisoners' Quarters} without breaking any door.

achievements.description: Reach the Arboretum for the first time.
achievements.summary: Make your first visit to the @loc{Dilapidated Arboretum}.

steps.text: Pick up the @item{Teleportation Rune} in the @loc{Toxic Sewers}.
In @loc{Prisoners' Quarters}, take the @item{Dilapidated Arboretum Key} near the exit to the Arboretum.
Take the @loc{Dilapidated Arboretum} exit.

achievements.displayName: The mud is getting warm, so you might as well swim.
achievements.description: Reach the Morass of the Banished for the first time.
achievements.summary: Make your first visit to the @loc{Morass of the Banished}.

steps.text: Take the @loc{Morass of the Banished} exit from the @loc{Promenade of the Condemned} or the @loc{Dilapidated Arboretum}.

achievements.description: Reach the Nest for the first time.
achievements.summary: Make your first visit to the @loc{Nest}.

steps.text: Take the @loc{Nest} exit from the @loc{Morass of the Banished}.

achievements.description: Reach the Corrupted Prison for the first time.
achievements.summary: Make your first visit to the @loc{Corrupted Prison}.

steps.text: Pick up the @item{Spider Rune} in the @loc{Slumbering Sanctuary}.
In a later run, take the @loc{Corrupted Prison} exit from the @loc{Toxic Sewers}.

achievements.description: Reach the Derelict Distillery for the first time!
achievements.summary: Make your first visit to the @loc{Derelict Distillery}.

guide.context: The Distillery exit appears in the @loc{Clock Room} only after you have reached the @loc{Throne Room} and fought the @enemy{Hand of the King} once.

steps.text: Beat the boss of the @loc{Clock Room}, then take the @loc{Derelict Distillery} exit.

achievements.description: You completed the Derelict Distillery without using the Barrel Launcher!
achievements.summary: Complete the Derelict Distillery without ever touching the Barrel Launcher.

steps.text: Enter @loc{Derelict Distillery} and never interact with the @item{Barrel Launcher}, not even to pick it up.
Reach the end of the biome.

achievements.description: You killed an Infected Worker with his own barrel!
achievements.summary: Kill an Infected Worker with that enemy's own barrel.

steps.text: Go to @loc{Derelict Distillery} and find an @enemy{Infected Worker}.
When it throws or lays down a barrel, hit that barrel with an attack so it is knocked back, and let it explode on the worker.

achievements.description: Reach the Mausoleum for the first time.
achievements.summary: Make your first visit to the @loc{Mausoleum}.

steps.text: Reach the @loc{Undying Shores} and take the @loc{Mausoleum} exit.

achievements.description: Reach the Undying Shores for the first time.
achievements.summary: Make your first visit to the @loc{Undying Shores}.

steps.text: In the @loc{Fractured Shrines}, pick up the @item{Cultist Outfit} from a corpse on a large floating island and equip it.
Take the @loc{Undying Shores} exit with the outfit on.

achievements.description: Reach the Fractured Shrines for the first time.
achievements.summary: Make your first visit to the @loc{Fractured Shrines}.

steps.text: Reach the @loc{Black Bridge}, beat the @enemy{Concierge}, and take the @loc{Fractured Shrines} exit.

achievements.description: Defeat the Scarecrow without bouncing on any mushrooms.
achievements.summary: Beat the @enemy{Scarecrow} without using any mushroom to bounce.

steps.text: Fight the @enemy{Scarecrow} in the @loc{Mausoleum} and stay off every mushroom in the arena.

achievements.description: You beat the Scarecrow!
achievements.summary: Defeat the @enemy{Scarecrow}.

steps.text: Go through the @loc{Black Bridge} to the @loc{Fractured Shrines} and search the corpses on the large floating islands until a @item{Cultist Outfit} drops.
Wear the @item{Cultist Outfit} at the gate of the @loc{Undying Shores} so that it opens.
Go on to the @loc{Mausoleum} and defeat the @enemy{Scarecrow}.

achievements.description: You beat the Scarecrow without taking a single hit!
achievements.summary: Defeat the @enemy{Scarecrow} without being hit even once.

steps.text: Defeat the @enemy{Scarecrow} in the @loc{Mausoleum} without being hit.

achievements.description: Let an Apostate revive at least 3 souls.
achievements.summary: Watch an Apostate bring back 3 dead enemies.

steps.text: Find an @enemy{Apostate} and defeat enemies near it until it has revived 3 of them.

achievements.description: Summon the Serenade skill while another pet skill is already active.
achievements.summary: Summon the Serenade skill while another pet skill is already active.

guide.context: Avoid Maria's Cat for this: the cat chases Serenade away instead.

steps.text: Find @item{Serenade} in the secret area of @loc{Fractured Shrines}.
In a passage, summon a pet such as @item{Great Owl of War} first, then summon @item{Serenade} and watch for the cutscene.

achievements.description: Electrify an enemy with the Lightning Rods while they are in water.
achievements.summary: Electrify an enemy that is standing in water with the Lightning Rods.

steps.text: Get the @item{Lightning Rods}, which drop from Failed Homunculi.
Place both rods so an enemy standing in water is between them.

achievements.description: Defeat at least 5 enemies in a row with the Scarecrow's Sickles.
achievements.summary: Kill 5 enemies back to back using the Scarecrow's Sickles.

steps.text: Get the @item{Scarecrow's Sickles} from @enemy{The Scarecrow}.
Use only the Sickles to kill 5 enemies in a row.

achievements.description: Trap an enemy using the Fractured Shrines environment!
achievements.summary: Catch an enemy in a trap that belongs to the Fractured Shrines biome.

steps.text: Fight in @loc{Fractured Shrines} and lure an enemy into the pits, rotating axes or swinging logs there so a hazard catches it.

achievements.displayName: The cowl does not make the monk
achievements.description: Wear the Cultist Outfit to enter the Undying Shores.
achievements.summary: Wear the Cultist Outfit to enter the Undying Shores.

steps.text: Loot the corpses on the big floating islands in @loc{Fractured Shrines} until the @item{Cultist Outfit} drops.
Equip it and go through the door to @loc{Undying Shores}.

achievements.description: Reach the Shipwreck for the first time!
achievements.summary: Make your first visit to the @loc{Infested Shipwreck}.

steps.text: In the @loc{Stilt Village}, take the @item{Crowned Key} inside the lighthouse keeper's home.
Take the @loc{Infested Shipwreck} exit from the @loc{Clock Room}.

achievements.description: Reach the Lighthouse for the first time!
achievements.summary: Make your first visit to the @loc{Lighthouse}.

steps.text: Take the @loc{Lighthouse} exit from the @loc{Infested Shipwreck}.

achievements.description: Reach the Crown for the first time!
achievements.summary: Make your first visit to @loc{The Crown}.

steps.text: Beat @enemy{The Servants} in the @loc{Lighthouse}, then take the exit to @loc{The Crown}.

achievements.description: You beat the Queen!
achievements.summary: Defeat the @enemy{Queen}.

steps.text: Go from the @loc{Clock Room} through the @loc{Infested Shipwreck} and @loc{Lighthouse} to @loc{The Crown}.
Defeat the @enemy{Queen}.

achievements.description: You beat the Queen without taking a single hit!
achievements.summary: Defeat the @enemy{Queen} without being hit even once.

steps.text: Defeat the @enemy{Queen} in @loc{The Crown} without being hit.

achievements.description: Beat the Queen by pushing her into the void
achievements.summary: Beat the @enemy{Queen} by knocking her off into the void so the fall kills her.

steps.text: In @loc{The Crown}, push the @enemy{Queen} into the void; the fall damage must deal the final blow.

achievements.description: Beat the Queen with the Killing Deck
achievements.summary: Defeat the @enemy{Queen} while using the @item{Killing Deck}.

steps.text: Unlock and find the @item{Killing Deck}, which drops from @enemy{Armored Shrimp} enemies.
Equip the @item{Killing Deck} and defeat the @enemy{Queen} with it.

achievements.description: Beat the Queen with a Queen outfit
achievements.summary: Defeat the @enemy{Queen} while wearing the @item{Queen Outfit}.

steps.text: Defeat the @enemy{Queen} once to get the @item{Queen Outfit}.
Equip the outfit, start a new run, and defeat the @enemy{Queen} again.

achievements.description: Get the Leghugger to evolve
achievements.summary: Make the @item{Leghugger} skill creature evolve into its adult form.

steps.text: Get the @item{Leghugger} skill from the lore room in @loc{Stilt Village}, then equip it.
Summon it in fights and let it keep attacking enemies until it is sated and evolves.

achievements.description: Kill a Pirate Captain with the Scavenged Bombard
achievements.summary: Defeat a Pirate Captain using the Scavenged Bombard skill.

steps.text: Get the @item{Scavenged Bombard}, which drops from Pirate Captains.
Kill a @enemy{Pirate Captain} with it at close range.

achievements.description: Kill five enemies with a single throw and recall of the Wrecking Ball
achievements.summary: Use a single throw-and-recall cycle of the @item{Wrecking Ball} to kill five enemies.

steps.text: Get the @item{Wrecking Ball}, which drops when @enemy{Calliope} is the last Servant killed.
Group at least five enemies, use the third attack to throw the ball, then the fourth attack to recall it so that five enemies die from that one throw and recall.

achievements.description: Throw an enemy into spikes using the Hand Hook
achievements.summary: Throw an enemy into spikes with the Hand Hook.

steps.text: Get the @item{Hand Hook}, which drops from Armored Shrimps.
Position yourself so the enemy thrown by the last attack lands on spikes.

achievements.displayName: Put that thing back where it came from or so help me
achievements.description: Help the shark get back to the water
achievements.summary: Help the shark from the @item{Maw of the Deep} weapon get back to the water.

steps.text: Get the @item{Maw of the Deep} melee weapon, which drops from @enemy{Mutineers}.
Use its third attack, which throws the shark, to send the shark back into the water.

achievements.description: Finish the Lighthouse while wearing a Servant outfit
achievements.summary: Finish the @loc{Lighthouse} while wearing the @item{Servant Outfit}.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{The Servants} to get the @item{Servant Outfit}.
Equip the @item{Servant Outfit}, start a new run, and defeat @enemy{The Servants} in the @loc{Lighthouse} again.

achievements.description: Have 2 pets active at the same time
achievements.summary: Have two pets active at the same time.

steps.text: Get the @item{Great Owl of War}, which drops from @enemy{Knife Throwers} at 1 or more Boss Stem Cells.
Get one more pet skill from a DLC you own: @item{Mushroom Boi!} (The Bad Seed), @item{Leghugger} (The Queen and the Sea) or @item{Maria's Cat} (Return to Castlevania).
Equip both skills, summon both pets and keep them out together; the owl vanishes if you take damage.

achievements.description: Get the Leghugger to kill an Armored Shrimp
achievements.summary: Have a summoned @item{Leghugger} kill an @enemy{Armored Shrimp}.

steps.text: Get the @item{Leghugger} skill from the lore room in @loc{Stilt Village}, then equip it.
Go to the @loc{Infested Shipwreck}, where @enemy{Armored Shrimp} live.
Summon the @item{Leghugger} near an @enemy{Armored Shrimp} and let the Leghugger land the killing hit.

achievements.description: You finished the Lighthouse!
achievements.summary: Finish the @loc{Lighthouse} by defeating all three Servants.

steps.text: Reach the @loc{Infested Shipwreck}, then the @loc{Lighthouse}.
Defeat @enemy{Calliope}, @enemy{Euterpe} and @enemy{Kleio}.

achievements.description: Finish the  without taking any damage.
achievements.summary: Finish the @loc{Lighthouse} without taking any damage.

steps.text: Reach the @loc{Lighthouse} and defeat all three Servants without taking a single hit in the whole biome.

achievements.displayName: The Bank always wins in the end
achievements.description: Reach the Bank for the first time.
achievements.summary: Make your first visit to the @loc{Bank}.

steps.text: Enter the @loc{Throne Room} once.
In a later run, step into the golden chest when it randomly appears in a passage to a non-boss biome.

achievements.displayName: Up to the eyeball in debt
achievements.description: Beat the game with the maximum debt remaining.
achievements.summary: Beat the game with the maximum Bank debt still unpaid.

guide.context: Breaking the gold door adds curse points instead of paying: 5 per 1,000 debt, up to 100.

steps.text: Use the ATMs in the @loc{Bank} again and again; each use adds 2,000 debt.
Leave the debt unpaid when the gold door appears, and keep going to the end of the game.

achievements.description: Kill a .
achievements.summary: Kill a @enemy{Vendor Mimic}.

steps.text: Go to the @loc{Bank} and use one of the merchants' shops; interacting with an item there makes the @enemy{Vendor Mimic} reveal itself.
Defeat it. It drops an improved version of the item you picked.

achievements.displayName: Am I still on the island?
achievements.description: Reach the Castle's Outskirts for the first time.
achievements.summary: Make your first visit to the @loc{Castle's Outskirts}.

steps.text: Take the @loc{Castle's Outskirts} exit from @loc{Prisoners' Quarters}.

achievements.description: Reach Dracula's Castle for the first time.
achievements.summary: Make your first visit to @loc{Dracula's Castle}.

steps.text: Take the @loc{Dracula's Castle} exit from the @loc{Castle's Outskirts}.

achievements.description: Reach the Defiled Necropolis for the first time.
achievements.summary: Make your first visit to the @loc{Defiled Necropolis}.

steps.text: Take the @loc{Defiled Necropolis} exit from @loc{Dracula's Castle}.

achievements.description: Reach the Master's Keep for the first time.
achievements.summary: Make your first visit to the @loc{Master's Keep}.

steps.text: Beat @enemy{Death} in the @loc{Defiled Necropolis} once.
Take the @loc{Dracula's Castle} exit from the @loc{Clock Room}.
Find the @item{Petrified Key} in @loc{Dracula's Castle} and open the door to the @loc{Master's Keep}.

achievements.displayName: Death comes for us all... but not you!
achievements.description: You beat Death!
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Death}.

steps.text: Go through the @loc{Castle's Outskirts} and @loc{Dracula's Castle} to the @loc{Defiled Necropolis}.
Defeat @enemy{Death}.

achievements.description: Defeat  without being hit even once.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Death} without being hit even once.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Death} in the @loc{Defiled Necropolis} without being hit.

achievements.displayName: You don't belong in this world!
achievements.description: You beat Dracula!
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Dracula}.

steps.text: Go from the @loc{Clock Room} through @loc{Dracula's Castle} to the @loc{Master's Keep}.
Defeat @enemy{Dracula}.

achievements.description: Defeat .
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Dracula - Final Form}.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Dracula} in the @loc{Master's Keep}.
Defeat @enemy{Dracula - Final Form}, who appears right after.

achievements.description: Defeat  without being hit even once.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Dracula - Final Form} without being hit even once.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Dracula} in the @loc{Master's Keep}.
Defeat @enemy{Dracula - Final Form} without being hit.

achievements.description: Have Maria's Cat deal the last hit to Death.
achievements.summary: Have Maria's Cat deal the final hit to Death.

steps.text: Get the @item{Maria's Cat} skill by petting Byakko in Maria Renard's cell in @loc{Castle's Outskirts}.
Fight @enemy{Death} with the cat summoned and let the cat land the killing blow.

achievements.description: Kill a Werewolf with a Throwing Axe
achievements.summary: Defeat a Werewolf using a thrown Throwing Axe.

steps.text: Get the @item{Throwing Axe}, which drops from @enemy{Axe Armor} hiding among the statues of @loc{Dracula's Castle}.
Throw it so it lands on a @enemy{Werewolf} (found in @loc{Castle's Outskirts} and @loc{Dracula's Castle}) and finishes it.

achievements.displayName: Does what it says on the tin
achievements.description: Defeat  while fighting with the .
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Dracula - Final Form} while fighting with the @item{Vampire Killer}.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Dracula - Final Form} once to get the @item{Vampire Killer}, and unlock it.
In a new run, find the @item{Vampire Killer} and use it as your weapon through @loc{Master's Keep}.
Defeat @enemy{Dracula}, then @enemy{Dracula - Final Form}, with it.

achievements.description: Hit the same enemy with 5 orbiting Bibles in short succession.
achievements.summary: Strike one enemy with 5 Bible projectiles within a few seconds.

steps.text: Get the @item{Bible}, which drops from @enemy{Werewolf}s in @loc{Castle's Outskirts} and @loc{Dracula's Castle}.
Land its second attack on a single enemy: when it hits, it throws a rotary projectile. Keep going until 5 Bible projectiles hit that enemy in quick succession.
